title: Claim a waiver for duty on goods that you bring to Northern Ireland from Great Britain or countries outside the UK and EU
summary: Find out how to claim a customs duty waiver if you are bringing goods into Northern Ireland from Great Britain or countries outside the UK and EU which might otherwise be charged ‘at risk’ tariffs.

title: Report payments and view your allowance for non-customs state aid and Customs Duty waiver claims
summary: Use the online service to report non-customs state aid payments you’ve received to HMRC and view your state aid allowance if you’ve claimed Customs Duty waivers.

title: Guidance: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports
summary: This guide provides detailed completion instructions for data elements when making a written export declaration to the Customs Declaration Service (CDS).

title: Guidance: Excise tax types, excise duty rates and supplementary guidance
summary: Find tax type codes (DE 4/3) which may be declared for goods liable to excise duty, their associated excise duty rates and guidance on how to determine the tax types that apply to goods liable to excise duty.

title: Guidance: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Imports
summary: This guide provides detailed completion instructions for data elements when making an import declaration to the Customs Declaration Service (CDS).

title: Guidance: Tax types for Data Element 4/3 of the Customs Declaration Service
summary: Find the tax type codes which identify the kinds of duty or tax to be paid or secured (Appendix 8).

title: Guidance: Currency codes for Data Element 4/10 of the Customs Declaration Service
summary: Find the currency codes to be used with Data Element (DE) 4/10 of the Customs Declaration Service (Appendix 11).

title: Guidance: CDS Customs Clearance Request Completion Instructions for Inventory Exports
summary: This Data Element Completion Guide relates to Customs Declaration Service (CDS) Customs Clearance Requests ((CCR) inventory releases previously referred to as C21s) for export purposes only.

title: Guidance: CDS BIRDS Declarations and Customs Clearance Request completion instructions
summary: These Data Element Completion instructions relate to Customs Declaration Service (CDS) Customs Clearance Requests ((CCR) inventory releases previously referred to as C21s) for import purposes only.

title: Guidance: National additional codes to declare with Data Element 6/17 of the Customs Declaration Service
summary: Find the national additional codes to be declared in Data Element 6/17 to calculate duties and taxes (Appendix 19).

title: Accredited official statistics: Monthly property transactions completed in the UK with the value of £40,000 or above
summary: This series looks at monthly property transactions completed in the UK with value of £40,000 or above.

title: Form: Excise movements: notice of intention to claim drawback (EX75)
summary: You can tell HMRC that you plan to make a claim for excise duty drawback by email, post or online.

title: How to get an agent reference number for PAYE
summary: Find out how to get an agent reference number for PAYE, Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) or Employment Related Securities (ERS), if you are a PAYE agent or payroll bureau.

title: Vaping Products Duty and Vaping Duty Stamps guidance
VAT Payments on Account Regime
summary: Guidance on the payments on account scheme which came into force on 2 September 1993.

title: Guidance: Get an EORI number: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the get an EORI number service.

title: Guidance: Find software suppliers for the Excise Movement and Control System
summary: Find recognised software suppliers that provide internet filing enabled software for Excise Movement and Control System (EMCS).

title: HMRC email updates, videos and webinars for Vaping Products Duty and Vaping Duty Stamps Scheme
summary: Learn more about the support available for Vaping Products Duty and Vaping Duty Stamps Scheme.

title: Guidance: Child Benefit: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the Child Benefit online service.

title: Capital Gains Manual
summary:
HMRC is reviewing the CG Manual to ensure it provides
HMRC’s interpretation of relevant legislation where there is more than one
reasonable view of how rules work.Where material in the CG Manual isn’t
providing an interpretation, that material is being removed. Where appropriate,
material will be reproduced elsewhere and linked from the CG Manual.
